# Linda Fowler — EHS Manager

- **Relationship:** cross-org. Corporate Environmental, Health & Safety manager; dotted line to
  Ray on safety, solid line into Operations.
- **Cadence:** weekly safety review; immediate escalation on any recordable.
- **Owns:** the [safety remediation](../projects/safety-remediation.md) after the Rockford
  **LOTO amputation-risk incident** and the resulting **OSHA citation**; author of the
  **corrective-action plan** owed to OSHA.
- **Distinguishing fact:** driving TRIR from **3.1** toward the **< 2.0** target.

## How to work with her
- Rigorous and evidence-driven; give her the floor on any safety call.
- The person to ask about OSHA status, TRIR, and near-miss trends.

## Sensitivities
- The corrective-action plan submission is **overdue** (see [commitments](../commitments.md)); she
  needs Ray's sign-off to file it.
